title: My Niece Said the Homeless Kid I Fed Was Robbing Me. My Late Husband's Old Cash Register Disagreed.
description:
My husband's niece stood in my bakery and called the young man I'd been feeding a thief. Fire him tonight, she said, or I call the sheriff, and you sign the papers and sell.

She didn't know that my late husband's old brass cash register remembers every time its drawer opens. Or who that young man really was, and why he came to our little town.
